basic_details.short_information: The Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre (HBCHRC) has officially announced the Clerk Recruitment 2026 with 2 openings. The detailed notification is available on the official website, https://tmc.gov.in/. Candidates up to 27 years of age who hold a Graduate degree from a recognized university with computer knowledge, good typing speed, proficiency in MS Office, and preferably one year of experience are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 06 August 2026. Direct links to download the notification and view the walk-in details are available on the official website.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Clerk Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HBCHRC Punjab Clerk Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Clerk Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 2 for the Clerk post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Any Graduate from recognized university, with good typing speed, computer knowledge and well versed in using MS office minimum 01 year experience is preferable.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Punjab Clerk Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Clerk post at HBCHRC Punjab is scheduled for 06 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Clerk position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is Any Graduate from a recognized university, with good typing speed, computer knowledge, and proficiency in MS Office. A minimum of 01 year of experience is preferable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Clerk post is 27 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Clerk role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 23,870 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Clerk post at HBCHRC Punjab.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an MCQ Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at HBCHRC Punjab, Mohali, Punjab, 140901.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested copies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).
